title: tabernaemontana johnstonii
intro: Tabernaemontana johnstonii, commonly known as the Johnston's tree, is a plant species within the Apocynaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tabernaemontana johnstonii include its ability to reduce inflammation and fever, making it a valuable remedy in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as vobasine and vobtusine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
